_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase ML). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1). Companion phrase pack: phrases/lofi/. Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-hiphop.md section 5 (that source-book's GM numbers are already 0-based). Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Lo-fi
blurb: Lo-fi hip-hop: a dusty swung nod, hazy rootless Rhodes 9th loops, a lazy upright two-feel bass, and a soft flute hook that leaves most of the bar empty.

flavors.label: Study Beat
flavors.blurb: The canonical swung ii-V-I-vi Rhodes loop, soft-edged and half-asleep.

flavors.label: Dorian Tunnel
flavors.blurb: Two m7 chords rocking back and forth for eight bars and never resolving.

flavors.label: Tape Jazz
flavors.blurb: Busier changes off a minor ii-V, comped in short chops over a walking upright.

flavors.label: One Chord Haze
flavors.blurb: A single m9 pad smeared across the whole loop -- all texture, no harmony.

flavors.label: Boom Bap Knock
flavors.blurb: Chopped Rhodes stabs on a tighter grid: the harder, drier end of the genre.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Lo-fi hip-hop harmony is borrowed jazz played sleepily: every chord carries at least a 7th and usually a 9th -- m7, maj7, m7b5 -- and a plain triad instantly breaks the spell. Favour two-chord Dorian vamps and stepwise ii-V-I-vi loops over four bars at 70-90bpm, swung hard. Resolve rarely; let the loop hang unfinished.
